# Exported one-shot policies: Python vs C++ and timing sensitivity (generated by scripts/audit_v2/policy_consistency.py)

Python = scikit-learn model refit exactly as in scripts/m3_train.py (select_full on all dev rows); C++ = the controller's own policy parser and evaluator (build/controller_unit eval, linked against the fpc2 library) reading the exported file. Rows = dev decision points (logged checkpoint features).

| policy | model | rows | max abs score diff | action disagreements | missing-value rows | missing: max diff / disagreements | switch share | action flips at r_time ×0.90 / ×0.95 / ×1.05 / ×1.10 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `configs/policies/m3_oneshot_D_K1000_time.txt` | linear (logit {'C': 0.1}) | 769 | 2.54e-09 | 0 | 2307 | 2.54e-09 / 0 | 0.044 | 0.5% / 0.4% / 0.1% / 0.5% |
| `configs/policies/m3_oneshot_Iminus_K10000_time.txt` | tree (tree {'max_depth': 1, 'min_samples_leaf': 10}) | 742 | 3.26e-07 | 0 | 2226 | 3.26e-07 / 0 | 0.000 | 0.0% / 0.0% / 0.0% / 0.0% |
| `configs/policies/audit_v2/m3_oneshot_D_K1000_time.txt` | linear (logit {'C': 0.1}) | 769 | 2.54e-09 | 0 | 2307 | 2.54e-09 / 0 | 0.044 | 0.5% / 0.4% / 0.1% / 0.5% |
| `configs/policies/audit_v2/m3_oneshot_Iminus_K10000_time.txt` | tree (tree {'max_depth': 1, 'min_samples_leaf': 10}) | 742 | 3.26e-07 | 0 | 2226 | 3.26e-07 / 0 | 0.000 | 0.0% / 0.0% / 0.0% / 0.0% |

Notes: scikit-learn trees compare float32-cast inputs with float32 thresholds while the C++ evaluator uses doubles with the 9-digit printed thresholds; a disagreement could only occur for inputs within float32 rounding of a threshold. All exported policies contain r_time (CPU seconds to reach the prefix), so deployed decisions depend on measured time; the flip shares quantify that dependence for realistic relative timing noise (M1: repeat-to-repeat p95 about 5–9%).
